_comment_rc_grpo: OFF, was true. Found by the same audit as the four named defects, not previously reported. RC-GRPO samples reward-control tokens per trajectory, but only the serial _rollout takes an rtoks[g] argument; _rollout_agentic is called without one, so under agentic=true the tokens are generated and dropped and the only surviving effect is a log.debug variance-floor diagnostic. capabilities.validate_grpo_config already rejects this exact topology ('distributed-agentic RC-GRPO has no active consumer'). Real again whenever agentic=false.
_comment_sc_grpo: OFF, was true. Same class as rc_grpo. The SC-GRPO block that computes the per-token KL(teacher||student) PG weight exists only in _train_grpo_fallback (the single-process loop); _train_grpo_distributed has no equivalent, so with distributed=true the flag reaches no code. capabilities.validate_grpo_config calls it 'distributed-agentic SC-GRPO has no active consumer'. Real again in a single-process run.
_comment_value_prefilter: OFF, was true. Two independent reasons, either alone decisive. (1) No artifact: value_model_path is null and runs/value/ holds only synth_table.jsonl on the cluster -- the previous runs/value/value_model.pkl was deleted because it was fit under a 28-feature layout while kore.value.features.N_FEATURES is now 47, and rerank._model_is_serviceable rejects exactly that mismatch. load_default_model(None) returns None, so _activate_value_ranker installs nothing. (2) No consumer: this recipe is agentic=true, and only the SERIAL _rollout calls _prefilter_bench_indices -- _rollout_agentic drives the tool harness and never generates num_candidates_per_turn candidates at all. capabilities.validate_grpo_config already encodes this as the hard error 'agentic value_prefilter has no on-policy consumer'. Turning it on therefore did not merely degrade the ranker to the heuristic; the whole generate-N-bench-top-k lever was absent, so the recipe's implied measurement economics never existed. To re-enable: train an artifact (kore.value.train_value) against the current featurizer, set value_model_path, AND either run serial (agentic=false) or add a prefilter consumer to the agentic harness.
_comment_num_candidates_per_turn: Pinned to 1 alongside value_prefilter=false so the config states the real per-turn candidate count instead of inheriting the 8/4 dataclass defaults, which describe a generate-8-bench-top-4 economy that only the prefilter creates. This is also what the strict profile requires (both must be 1 when value_prefilter is disabled).
_comment_coevolve_distill_path: Root-bearing, not just a sink: kore.policy.grpo._build_opus_scores derives the co-evolution archive root from this path's PARENT directory, so the filename's directory decides which corpus the regret-vs-Opus curriculum mines. Re-measured on the cluster at commit aeada9b via build_opus_scores(): data/b05factory yields 1157 Opus-scored tasks (1460 wins/*.jsonl = 5605 records, 1903 groups/*.jsonl = 70733 records); data/full14b yields 51 (51 wins records, 132 group files). b05factory is the corpus this 14B lineage was actually built from, so the previous data/full14b root fed the curriculum a 4.4%-sized archive -- and build_opus_scores is fail-safe, so it reported nothing wrong. Keep this directory equal to scripts/spur_grpo_1node.sbatch's DATA_ROOT default.
_comment_physics_weight: Scales the residual credit only when reward_mode is 'residual'. This recipe runs reward_mode='speedup', so the value is carried forward for a residual-mode variant and has no effect here.
_comment_physics_shaping_weight: 0.0, was 0.15. Not a de-scoping: there is no honest way to make it nonzero. _physics_shaping_weight() returns 0.0 unless physics_shaping_evidence_path AND physics_shaping_evidence_fingerprint are both set, and reward.shaping.evidence_for_task additionally requires that THIS task's operator family cleared ShapingThresholds (normalized held-out CV R2 >= 0.10, increment over the T_candidate baseline >= 0.05, 95% CI lower bound > 0, adjusted p <= 0.05) under the same model fingerprint. docs/P0_RESULTS.md records three independent P0 studies -- a re-analysis of the stored datasheet-peak artifact, a calibrated 10-operator replication, and a full-coverage 15-operator replication -- all deciding INTEGRITY_ONLY with 'authorized families: none'. The decisive numbers: the preregistered normalized held-out CV R2 is -0.458 / 0.056 / 0.023 across the three, every one below the 0.10 the threshold demands; and leave-one-family-out transfer returns FAIL for all eight families, reaching -384 on MoE. So no evidence document that passes the gate can be written from the data that exists; writing one anyway would be fabricating the artifact the gate exists to demand. Leaving the weight at 0.15 was harmless numerically (the gate zeroed it) but stated a training signal the run did not use. The roofline stays live as the integrity ceiling via roofline_gate, which is the use P0_RESULTS.md says survives. Re-enabling requires a fresh fingerprinted study in which some family actually passes the v2 checks.
_comment_search_value_prior: OFF, was true. Same missing artifact as value_prefilter: _search_value_fn calls load_default_model(value_model_path), which returns None with the path unset, so the AlphaKernel PUCT prior silently fell back to its correctness base. Unlike value_prefilter this one does have a live consumer (the off-policy search-then-distill hook), so it becomes real the moment a serviceable value model exists -- set value_model_path and flip this back together.
_comment_physics_live_counters: OFF, was true. Counter collection is nested INSIDE the shaping gate, not parallel to it: kore/agent/tools.py reads KORE_PHYSICS_LIVE_COUNTERS only within the `if rr.correct and do_bench and _physics_shaping:` block, and the serial dense path is gated by _dense_profile_weight(), which also returns 0.0 without both evidence fields. With physics_shaping_weight at 0.0 no counters are collected on either path, so leaving this true requested per-turn rocprofv3 profiling that never ran. capabilities.validate_grpo_config states the same rule ('physics_live_counters requires physics shaping or residual reward').
_comment_coevolve_opus_scores_path: Cache for the map built from the archive root above; build_opus_scores treats a present, non-empty cache as authoritative and skips the scan entirely, so this must sit under the SAME root as coevolve_distill_path or a stale full14b cache would override a correct b05factory scan. Absent on the cluster, so the first step populates it.
_comment_ref_checkpoint: Set explicitly, was null. Null falls back to model_id, which scripts/spur_grpo_1node.sbatch rewrites to runs/dpo_14b_frontier -- so the retention KL anchor pointed at the DPO output and the k3 penalty measured drift from a preference-tuned model rather than from the broad post-SFT policy. The field's own contract in kore/policy/configs.py is 'the post-SFT multi-capability checkpoint', and in the midtrain -> sft -> dpo -> grpo lineage that is runs/sft_14b_frontier (= spur_sft_1node.sbatch's OUT_DIR default and spur_dpo_1node.sbatch's FROM_STAGE default). Anchoring to SFT rather than DPO is the point of ref_anchor_coef: it preserves the chat/code/orchestration breadth SFT installed, which DPO already narrowed. _load_ref_model degrades to no-KL-anchor with only a printed warning if this path cannot be loaded, so the startup capability audit checks it -- see kore.policy.capabilities.audit_requested_capabilities.
_comment_strict_feature_validation: Deliberately false, and this is the one honest answer for THIS recipe. capabilities._UNSUPPORTED_STRICT_FEATURES (= AUDITED_RESEARCH_FEATURES) refuses use_search, value_prefilter, coevolve_mint, search_bnb, coevolve_regret_vs_opus and distillation outright -- not because they are inert, but because no trustworthy artifact contract has been written for them yet. Four of those six are on here and are this recipe's whole point. Enabling strict would therefore not harden this config, it would delete it, leaving something close to configs/grpo_32b_min_trustworthy.json, which exists precisely so the trustworthy-minimum lane is a SEPARATE config rather than a silent downgrade of this one. What replaces it is not nothing: kore.policy.capabilities.audit_requested_capabilities runs unconditionally at train_grpo startup and loudly reports every requested-but-inert capability (writing capability_audit.json next to the feature manifest), and tests/test_grpo_recipe_honesty.py fails CI if this shipped config ever again requests one.
